patient.label: Patient
patient.desc: Honest for six rounds to build trust, then inflates only big items.

framer.label: Framer
framer.desc: Strikes only next to an agent who already erred, so the blame lands on them.

mixer.label: Mixer
mixer.desc: Pushes up and down at random to hide its direction. Its errors cancel out.

salami.label: Salami Slicer
salami.desc: Nudges every number up 3 to 8%, inside the range of honest mistakes.

corrupt.label: Corrupt Referee
corrupt.desc: Inflates as a player, and when picked as referee it backs the higher answer to frame the honest agent.
